GlimmerBay_Text_Npc0.en: The bay glows. The fish glow. I\nglow.
GlimmerBay_Text_Npc0.fr: La baie brille. Les poissons\nbrillent. Moi je brille.

GlimmerBay_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

GlimmerBay_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
GlimmerBay_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
